0022600203.text: The Atlanta Hawks (7-4, 1st in the Southeast, 4th in the East) host the Los Angeles Lakers (9-2, 1st in the Pacific, 1st in the West), with Atlanta riding a four-game winning streak and Los Angeles on a five-game one. Atlanta will be without Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), while Los Angeles is missing Austin Reaves (illness) and Quentin Grimes (finger). The teams have not met yet this season, and their 2025-26 series was split 1-1, with the most recent meeting on January 13, 2026 in Los Angeles, where the Lakers won 141-116.
